name: Spendflo
description: Spendflo MCP Server connects AI agents to Spendflo's AI-native Managed Procurement Platform, enabling programmatic access to procurement workflows, vendor intelligence, SaaS spend data, and contract information. Agents can retrieve purchase request status, vendor and contract details, and analyze spend data to support procurement decisions across the intake-to-procure lifecycle. By combining workflow visibility, expert-led negotiation services, and AI-driven insights, Spendflo helps organizations optimize costs, accelerate approval cycles, and gain full visibility and control over their technology and vendor spend.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Spendflo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Spendflo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-v2.spendflo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Spendflo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spendflo lists 29 MCP tools, including queryRequests, getRequestDetails, getRequestCount, findApproversForTask, queryVendors, getVendorDetails, getVendorCount, queryContracts, getContractDetails, getContractOverview, getContractSummary, and getUpcomingRenewals.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Spendflo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Spendflo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Spendflo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Spendflo is developed by Spendflo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
